notes.title: Thistlemine - Update Live!
notes.notes:
[list][*]Fixed some strange checkpoint behaviour starting from [spoiler]Astr Underground[/spoiler] up to the end of the game.
[*]Fixed a missing collision tile in the [spoiler]Astr Undeground[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed certain Glass Eye text and fixed missing quicksave checkpoints[/list]

notes.title: Update live with several fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Funeral Bouquet[/spoiler] not working while playing in Japanese.
[*] Fixed missing Japanese text for [spoiler]Armless[/spoiler] at the Rifts, also changed her stats a bit. (May or may not cause a character data desync bug for existing saves. If the data desync has occurred with a blank character joining the party at the end of [spoiler]Alternate Cosmos, please use a Charged Rock Hammer to avoid a potential softlock.[/spoiler]). Old Saves located in the Rifts may have a slightly bugged [spoiler]Armless[/spoiler]. This can be fixed by simply restarting Rifts.
[*] Added an extra turn to [spoiler]Marjorie[/spoiler], forced first action at the beginning of the battle.
[*] Portals at [spoiler]Somni's[/spoiler] checkpoint no longer take the player to Tulips.
[*] Portals at [spoiler]Cosmos Water Checkpoints[/spoiler] no longer lead to Tulips.
[/list]

notes.title: Test Your Mettle in Thistlemine!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961139/c4454206315fd06b7000b928338df5bfbe8f103e.png[/img]
Gather your will and wit! The dreaded exclusion zone awaits a brave excavator.

Thistlebro's solo developed puzzle RPG [b]Thistlemine [/b]is now available to play!

Three game modes and countless ways to progress through the game's 7 major areas bring you near endless challenge.

Can you reach the heart of the Exclusion Zone?

notes.title: New Demo Available in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961139/1868888e1183d191d575bc511cf60ab5bf7ea0f9.png[/img]

A new, updated demo is available to play in this Steam Next Fest!

Work your way through its manifold puzzles. Can you survive to the end?

[b]Thistlebro [/b]has been hard at work on the captivating puzzle RPG, and the currently estimated release date is in [b]Spring 2023[/b]! The full game and demo support English and Japanese languages.

You can support the game by wishlisting it on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090600/Thistlemine/

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2022 Limited Time Demo Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961139/341c33f7e07c3c4c45837ebf37b3dc55e6102682.png[/img]
Welcome to the world of [b]Thistlemine[/b]! The cute but dark puzzle RPG by [b]Thistlebro [/b]is releasing this winter!

A special Tokyo Game Show 2022 demo is now available to play!

The demo, which gives you a glimpse into the game's world and mechanics, can be played for a limited time through [b]October 2[/b].

Every battle is a unique challenge. Can you make it to the end?
